members.name: The Witch of God’s Curse · Illya
The Witch of God’s Curse · Illya

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Surge of Providence. The initial consecutive attacks’ damage becomes equal to 240% of her ATK.

Strengthens The Angel Who Bears “0”. The number of layers of [Multi-Barrier] becomes 3. The amount her HP is restored by when she takes damage that would reduce her HP to 0 becomes equal to 100% of her max HP.
At the start of the battle, if there are 2 or more Chaos Soul allies other than Illya in the party, this skill increases Illya’s DEF Break by 40% (cannot be dispelled).

levels.text: On that fateful day, Illya learned a new power from the person dearest to her. A power that will cut straight through every obstacle in her path, and lead everyone towards the future. Increases Illya’s chance to hit by 50% for 1 turn, and deals 10 physical attacks equal to 140% of her ATK to the enemy directly in front of her. If this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the consecutive attacks’ damage is multiplied by 3.
Additionally, if the target is not defeated by this skill, dispels 1 buff from them, and deals 1 physical attack equal to 580% of Illya’s ATK to them.
The initial consecutive attacks’ damage becomes equal to 180% of her ATK.

Illya possesses the will to protect the world, and the will to destroy it. When the balance between the two becomes disrupted, she will attain an unforgivable power. Activates if Illya is enhanced with [God’s Curse Unleashed]. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 340% of Illya’s ATK to enemies at random. After this skill activates, it will have no skill cooldown time.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, if a target is afflicted with a debuff, the physical attack’s damage to that target is multiplied by 1.5.
The number of physical attacks becomes 5.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 440% of her ATK.

“I thought I was ready...to give up my life and save the world. But, somewhere deep in my heart...” At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Devotion] to Illya (cannot be dispelled). [Devotion] makes Illya substitutively take 20% of the damage taken by another ally (this damage counts as taking an attack). If an ally, including Illya, is attacked, and the total number of times an ally, including Illya, has taken attacks becomes 10 or more (for attacks that are dealt to multiple targets, each hit to an ally, including Illya, is counted), or if the number of allies other than Illya who are alive becomes 0, this skill’s [Devotion] is dispelled, and this skill grants [God’s Curse Unleashed] to Illya for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This skill activates only 1 time per battle (during consecutive battles that take place in Guild Battles and Grand Battles, this skill activates 1 time each battle).
The number of turns of [God’s Curse Unleashed] becomes 5.
The number of turns of [God’s Curse Unleashed] becomes 8.

This is the guardian angel that shouldn’t exist—the result of demons’ schemes and angels’ deception. When an ally, including Illya, is attacked, the damage to Illya from that same enemy’s 2nd attack and onwards in the same turn is cut by 30% (for attacks that are dealt to multiple targets at the same time, they are counted as 1 attack regardless of how many times they deal damage). When she takes damage that would reduce her HP to 0, she survives with 1 HP, and restores HP equal to 20% of her max HP to her. The effect that lets Illya survive with 1 HP activates only 1 time per battle.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, grants 1 layer of [Multi-Barrier] to Illya (cannot be dispelled). If she takes damage, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.
The damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by 70%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Holy Torch. The targets whose HP are restored and whose debuffs are dispelled become the 3 allies with the highest ATK.
Strengthens Holy Torch. The increase in all ally targets’ chance to resist a debuff becomes 80%.
Strengthens Shining Shower. The amount all ally targets’ HP is restored by becomes equal to 100% of Priscilla’s ATK.

levels.text: A devastating explosion of flames deals 1 magical attack equal to 200% of Priscilla’s ATK to 3 random enemies. The holy flames also heal her friends, warding off the forces of evil. Restores HP equal to 50% of Priscilla’s ATK to the 2 allies with the highest ATK, and dispels 1 debuff each from those ally targets.
Additionally increases the chance to resist a debuff of the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 40% for 2 turns.

The number of debuffs that are dispelled from each ally target becomes 2. Additionally, if the initial magical attack deals 1 or more critical hits, the number of debuffs that are dispelled from each ally target becomes 3.

Rays of light pour down like rain from the heavens, dealing 1 magical attack equal to 200% of Priscilla’s ATK to 3 random enemies. The shining rain also heals her friends. Restores HP equal to 50% of Priscilla’s ATK to the 2 allies with the lowest remaining HP percentages, and grants [Regeneration] to those ally targets for 1 turn. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Regeneration] restores HP equal to 3% of an enhanced target’s max HP to them.

Additionally, if the initial magical attack deals 1 or more critical hits, the number of turns of [Regeneration] increases by 1. The number of turns of [Regeneration] is further increased by 1 for each time the initial magical attack deals a critical hit.
The ally targets whose HP are restored and are granted [Regeneration] become the 3 allies with the lowest remaining HP percentages.
The amount [Regeneration] restores an enhanced target’s HP by becomes equal to 5% of their max HP.
“I’ve always believed you’d come and save me...” Increases Priscilla’s max HP by 25% and M. DEF by 50% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally increases her chance to deal a critical hit by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her max HP increases by becomes 50%. The amount her M. DEF increases by becomes 100%. The increase in her chance to deal a critical hit becomes 40%.

Having endured countless days and nights of loneliness, Priscilla’s heart becomes her power to protect herself. At the start of the battle, this skill increases Priscilla’s DEF by 50% for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled). When she is inflicted with a debuff from an active skill, the number of turns of this skill’s [Increased DEF] is depleted by 1, and the numbers of turns of all her debuffs each decrease by 2.

When she is afflicted with a debuff from an active skill and the number of turns of [Increased DEF] is depleted, additionally restores HP equal to 50% of her ATK to the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage.
The number of turns of [Increased DEF] becomes 5.

members.name: The Witch of Snowy Illusions · Lunalynn

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Black Flames of Justice. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.

Strengthens Supreme Commander. At the start of the battle, additionally grants 2 layers of [Multi-Barrier] to all Chaos Soul allies other than Paladea (cannot be dispelled). If an ally target takes damage that is equal to 20% or higher of their max HP, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.

Strengthens Bullet Storm and Black Bullet. Bullet Storm’s physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 980% of Paladea’s ATK. Black Bullet’s physical attacks’ damage become equal to 1960% of Paladea’s ATK.

levels.text: Flames of justice once white, now tinged in black, engulf the enemy. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 480% of Paladea’s ATK to 4 random enemies.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, has a 70% chance to decrease all targets’ chance to resist a critical hit by 40% for 2 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 580% of her ATK.

“If I can still be of any help...!” Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 480% of Paladea’s ATK to enemies at random. “Even though I didn’t wish for this power, if I can use it to protect everyone, then I...!” Before dealing the physical attacks, if Paladea is enhanced with Witch of Justice’s [Increased Chance to Deal a Critical Hit] and its stack count is 20 or higher, the stack count becomes 0, and Black Bullet activates instead of Bullet Storm. Black Bullet deals 4 physical attack equal to 960% of Paladea’s ATK to enemies at random.
Strengthens Black Bullet. This skill becomes guaranteed to deal a critical hit.

Strengthens Black Bullet. Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, dispels 2 buffs each from all targets at the same time (the decision to dispel buffs based on Paladea’s Debuff ACC is done only once per target).
Bullet Storm’s physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 880% of Paladea’s ATK. Black Bullet’s physical attacks’ damage become equal to 1760% of Paladea’s ATK.

“...Use your power to save the world...until you use that very same power to destroy it.” Each time Paladea hears the demon whisper those words, her heart becomes tinged even more in black. If Paladea attacks and deals a critical hit, this skill grants her a buff that increases her chance to deal a critical hit by 1% (cannot be dispelled). The buff’s stack count is further increased by 1 for each time she deals a critical hit (20 stacks max).
This skill also becomes activated if an ally attacks and deals a critical hit. The buff’s stack count is also further increased by 1 for each time an ally attacks and deals a critical hit.

The increase in her chance to deal a critical hit becomes 2%, and its max increase becomes 40%. The buff’s stack count is further increased by 1 for each time Paladea or an ally attacks and deals a critical hit.

“I didn’t want to be a flame that burns demons away, but a light that warms the hearts of others...” At the start of the battle, this skill grants 3 layers of [Multi-Barrier] to Paladea (cannot be dispelled). If she takes damage that is equal to 20% or higher of her max HP, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.

Additionally, if Paladea attacks and deals a critical hit, grants 1 layer of [Multi-Barrier] to the Chaos Soul ally with the highest ATK for every 2 critical hits that attack deals (2 layers max) (cannot be dispelled). If the ally target takes damage that is equal to 10% or higher of their max HP, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.
The targets who are granted [Multi-Barrier] if Paladea attacks and deals a critical hit become the 3 Chaos Soul allies with the highest ATK.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Twilight’s Delusion. The chance to inflict [Silence] becomes 30%. If a target’s MAG is lower than Gil’uial’s MAG, the chance to inflict [Silence] on that target becomes 60%.
Strengthens Stardust. The chance to inflict [Silence] becomes 50%.
Strengthens Stardust. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 880% of her ATK.

levels.text: Gil’uial uses her magic to throw the enemy into a state of disarray, robbing them of their power. Dispels 1 buff each from the 2 enemies with the highest ATK.
Additionally, after dispelling the buffs, if a target’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or higher, this skill has a 20% chance to inflict [Silence] on that target for 1 turn.
After dispelling the buffs, if a target’s MAG is lower than Gil’uial’s MAG, the chance to inflict [Silence] on that target becomes 40%.
“Rest for all eternity!” Gil’uial uses her magic to let starlight rain down upon the enemy. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 780% of Gil’uial’s ATK to 2 random enemies.
Additionally, after dealing the magical attack, has a 40% chance to inflict [Silence] on all targets for 1 turn.
Additionally, before dealing the magical attack, if Gil’uial is afflicted with a debuff, the magical attack’s damage is multiplied by 2.
The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.
“Behold! Magic can also be used like this!” When Gil’uial is inflicted with a debuff from an active skill, this skill increases her chance to inflict a debuff by 15% for 1 turn.
This skill also becomes activated when Gil’uial is granted a buff from an active skill.
The increase in her chance to inflict a debuff becomes 30%.

“I shall teach you how a witch fights!” The knowledge Gil’uial wanted to leave behind for future generations allows her to draw out her power as a witch to its fullest potential. Increases her chance to resist a critical hit by 40% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, if a critical hit is dealt to Gil’uial, her chance to resist a critical hit is further increased by 20% (2 stacks, total increase of 80% max).
Additionally, at the start of the battle, grants 3 layers of [Multi-Barrier] to Gil’uial (cannot be dispelled). If she takes damage, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Siren’s Song. The decrease in all targets’ chance to deal a critical hit becomes 30%.

Strengthens Melody of Wishes. The size of the [Shield] granted to Aine becomes equal to 1500% of her unique type stat (total increase of 1700% max), and the size of each [Shield] granted to the 2 allies with the highest ATK becomes equal to 300% of their unique type stat (total increase of 500% max). Additionally, this skill now activates again after 1 action phase has ended since its previous activation.
Strengthens Ayre of Eternity. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Oh, melody of the night’s abyss...” An ominous song resounds from the depths, enchanting all who listen, before ushering them into the darkness. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 380% of Aine’s ATK to the 2 enemies with the highest ATK. Afterwards, this skill has a 70% chance to decrease all targets’ chance to deal a critical hit by 10% for 2 turns.
The targets of this skill become the 3 enemies with the highest ATK.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, increases Aine’s chance to inflict a debuff by 50% for 2 turns.

“If this shall allow me to atone...” Inflicts 1 stack of a debuff on Aine that decreases her SPD by 5% for 2 turns (3 stacks max). “Play, ayre of eternity...” Countless bubbles form, moving in unison with Aine’s song, and make their way towards the enemy. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 250% of her ATK to 2 random enemies, and inflicts 1 stack of a debuff on those enemy targets that decreases their DEF by 5% for 2 turns (3 stacks max). This skill then reactivates (2 reactivations max).
The amount 1 stack of the debuff decreases all targets’ DEF by becomes 15%.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, if Aine is not afflicted with [Demon’s Temptation], the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 3.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 350% of her ATK.

The emotions woven into a single melody emanate from a pure heart that wishes to protect all that is precious to it. At the start of the turn, this skill grants Aine and the 2 allies with the highest ATK [Shield], with each target’s [Shield] being equal to 100% of their unique type stat for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled). While the enhanced targets are enhanced with the [Shield] granted by this skill, it increases their chance to resist a critical hit by 60%. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation. If a target is already enhanced with the [Shield] granted by this skill, that target’s [Shield] will be overwritten with a new [Shield] equal to 100% of their unique type stat.
The size of each target’s [Shield] becomes equal to 200% of their unique type stat.

Additionally, the size of each target’s [Shield] is further increased by 20% of their unique type stat for each stack that the stack count of Aine’s [Demon’s Temptation] has been decreased by at the start of the turn (total increase of 400% max).

A demon’s whispers always find their way to the weakest of hearts. Such sweet whispers taint even the purest hearts with darkness. At the start of the battle, this skill inflicts 10 stacks of [Demon’s Temptation] on Aine (cannot be dispelled). “I shall shoulder every pain and sin I have committed. If that is what my heart is...!” Aine confronts her own weakness with the strength of her will, driving away the demon’s whispers, and awakening the righteous power she had buried inside. Each time the stack count of [Demon’s Temptation] decreases, this skill increases Aine’s ATK by 1% (10 stacks max). At the start of Aine’s action phase, the stack count of [Demon’s Temptation] decreases by 1 for each ally who is enhanced with the [Shield] granted by Melody of Wishes.
Each time the stack count of [Demon’s Temptation] decreases, the amount her ATK increases by becomes 2%.
Each time the stack count of [Demon’s Temptation] decreases, the amount her ATK increases by becomes 3%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Fatal Crush. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1120% of her ATK.
Strengthens Outpouring Feelings. The amount [Force Field] cuts the damage from the enemy’s attack by becomes 70%.
Strengthens No Mercy. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 490% of her ATK.

levels.text: “We’re all filthy beasts anyway. Let’s kill each other in the most hideous way possible.” Deals 1 physical attack equal to 620% of Iris’s ATK to the 3 enemies with the highest ATK.
Additionally, after dealing the physical attack, has a 70% chance to decrease all targets’ ATK by 10% for 2 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 920% of her ATK.
Iris does everything simply, ruthlessly, and without a single ounce of mercy. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 390% of her ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, if a target is afflicted with [Decreased ATK], the physical attack’s damage to that target is multiplied by 2.
The number of physical attacks becomes 6.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 440% of her ATK.

To be there at the side of the person who needs her and support them. That’s all Iris ever wanted. At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Force Field] to Iris for 2 turns. When an enhanced target of [Force Field] is attacked and takes damage that exceeds 20% of their max HP, the exceeding amount of damage to that enhanced target is cut by 50%.
Additionally grants [Force Field] to the ally with the highest ATK other than Iris for 2 turns.

Additionally grants [Force Field] to the ally with the highest SPD other than Iris for 2 turns. If this ally target is the same as the ally target with the highest ATK, these 2 buffs will overlap, causing this skill’s [Force Field] to be overwritten by the new [Force Field]. Thus, [Force Field] will only be granted to Iris and this ally target.

What twisted Iris’s fate was her indominable spirit that resists falling into despair. If Iris is attacked, and her remaining HP percentage becomes 30% or lower, this skill grants her [Shield] equal to 50% of her ATK for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This skill activates only 1 time per battle.
Additionally, the size of [Shield] is further increased by 50% of Iris’s ATK for each enemy who is alive when this skill activates (total increase of 300% max).
The number of turns of [Shield] becomes 3.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Special Service. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 500% of Richesse’s ATK.
Strengthens Special Service. The increase in all targets’ chance to resist a debuff becomes 100%.
Strengthens FlabbyCaptain! CHARGE! The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 590% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Time for some special service!♪” No one’s as thoroughly equipped as this battlefield merchant. Richesse prepares her allies for battle by unveiling a plethora of secret tools of the trade that will protect them. Grants Richesse and the ally with the lowest SPD [Shield] equal to 300% of Richesse’s ATK for 1 turn.
Additionally increases all targets’ chance to resist a debuff by 50% for 1 turn.
The numbers of turns of [Shield] and [Increased Chance to Resist a Debuff] each become 3.

“Go get ’em!” On Richesse’s signal, the captain of the flabbycatties, FlabbyCaptain, charges in for the attack. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 490% of Richesse’s ATK to 2 random enemies. While FlabbyCaptain’s stuck onto the enemies’ faces, this skill has a 20% chance to inflict [Silence] on all targets for 1 turn.
The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.
The chance to inflict [Silence] becomes 55%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 540% of her ATK.

“The two of us will overcome it all. Sins, pain—everything.” That inseparable presence saves Richesse’s heart from breaking, giving her the courage to stand up and fight. Increases Richesse’s DEF by 25% (cannot be dispelled).
The targets of this skill become Richesse and the ally with the lowest SPD.
The amount all targets’ DEF increases by becomes 50%.

Having a merchant on the battlefield will save the lives of many. If an ally is attacked, and their remaining HP percentage becomes 50% of lower, this skill grants that ally [Shield] equal to 300% of Richesse’s ATK for 1 turn. This skill will not activate again until 5 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
This skill now activates again after 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 500% of Richesse’s ATK.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Jamming Scattershot. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.
At the start of the battle, this skill increases the max HP of the 2 allies with the lowest SPD other than Fenny by 30% (cannot be dispelled).
Strengthens Magic Permeator. The damage from [Erosion] becomes equal to 50% of this skill’s total damage.

levels.text: Fenny detonates a jamming shell over the enemy that disrupts their operations, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 380% of Fenny’s ATK to 5 random enemies. Upon detonation, the shell releases special metal shards that rain down on the area. The metal shards have a 40% chance to decrease all targets’ chance to inflict a debuff by 50%, and inflict [Buff Immunity] on them for 2 turns. These 2 effects are treated as 1 debuff.
The number of turns of [Decreased Chance to Inflict a Debuff] and [Buff Immunity] becomes 4.
The chance to inflict [Decreased Chance to Inflict a Debuff] and [Buff Immunity] becomes 70%.

Fenny takes aim at the enemy confirmed to be the highest threat, and fires a special warhead powerful enough to destroy a demon from the inside out. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 580% of Fenny’s ATK to the enemy with the highest remaining HP percentage, and has a 40% chance to inflict [Erosion] on the target for 2 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Erosion] deals damage equal to 40% of this skill’s total damage. If this skill activates for the 2nd time and onward during battle, the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 2.
The number of turns of [Erosion] becomes 4.
The chance to inflict [Erosion] becomes 70%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 680% of her ATK.

A talent required for a first-rate artillery officer is the ability to immediately conceal themself once they have been designated their position. If Fenny is attacked, and her remaining HP percentage falls below 40% while the number of allies who are alive is 2 or more, this skill grants [Invisibility] to Fenny for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This skill activates only 1 time per battle.
When Fenny is attacked, the remaining HP percentage condition to grant her [Invisibility] becomes having a remaining HP percentage of below 70%.
The number of turns of [Invisibility] becomes 3.

Fenny can only use this special apparatus once due to it still being in its developmental stage, but its application has made it possible for the next round to be immediately loaded into her cannon. At the start of the 3rd turn, this skill makes Magic Permeator’s skill cooldown time 0. This skill activates only 1 time per battle.
At the start of the 3rd turn, additionally increases her SPD by 15% for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her SPD increases by becomes 30%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Kyouka Suigetsu. The numbers of turns of [Increased Chance to Deal a Critical Hit] and [Increased CRIT DMG Boost] each become 4.

Strengthens The Majestic Moon. Her counterattack damage becomes equal to 600% of her MAG. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 1000% of her ATK. Additionally, if the number of Sorcerer-type allies other than Kaguya in the party is 1 or more, Kaguya’s counterattack damage becomes equal to 900% of her MAG.
Strengthens Kochou-no-Yume. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 620% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Thou shalt strive for mine own sake.” Moonlight born from Kaguya’s fog of dreams pours down upon her allies, increasing the chance to deal a critical hit of all allies by 20% for 2 turns. When her foes gaze upon the moonlight, their hearts are captured by its dreamlike beauty...only for those tranquil illusions to turn into violent nightmares. Afterwards, this skill deals 1 magical attack equal to 280% of Kaguya’s ATK to 5 random enemies.
Additionally, before dealing the magical attack, increases all allies’ CRIT DMG Boost by 20% for 2 turns.

The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to
380% of her ATK.
“Fall deep into thy dream, and never awaken!” Kaguya’s fog of dreams throws her foes into disarray, dealing 1 magical attack equal to 420% of her ATK to 4 random enemies.
The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
Additionally, before dealing the magical attack, if a target is afflicted with a debuff, the magical attack’s damage to that target is multiplied by 1.5.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 560% of her ATK.

“I alone must continue to live. Such is my duty as the one who was kept alive.” At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Counter Shift] to Kaguya for 4 turns (cannot be dispelled). Her counterattack damage becomes equal to 200% of her MAG. At the start of each turn or when Kaguya is attacked, if her remaining HP percentage is below 100%, [Counter Shift] is dispelled. The moon is without equal, thus not a soul is allowed to touch her. At the start of the 1st turn, this skill also grants Kaguya [Shield] equal to 200% of her ATK for 4 turns (cannot be dispelled).
Her counterattack damage becomes equal to 300% of her MAG.
The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 400% of her ATK.

The darker the night, the brighter the shine of the noble, beautiful moon. When Kaguya is inflicted with a debuff from an enemy’s active skill, this skill has a 70% chance to decrease that enemy’s PM. DEF Break by 25% and ATK by 10% for 4 turns. These 2 effects are treated as
1 debuff.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, decreases the damage Kaguya takes by 40% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount the target’s PM. DEF Break decreases by becomes 50%, and the amount their ATK decreases by becomes 20%.

members.name: Soldier of the Summer Breeze · Sabrina

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Cerulean Tempest. The targets of the physical attack become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens Ultramarine Requiem. The number of initial physical attacks becomes 7.
Strengthens Cerulean Tempest. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 400% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Pierce the sea and sky!” yells Sabrina as she swiftly thrusts her blade, leaving the enemy with no time to even catch their breath. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 350% of her ATK to 4 random enemies. The summer breeze then turns violent, robbing the enemy of their consciousness. This skill takes the enemy with the highest remaining HP percentage among the targets of the physical attack, and inflicts [Fainted] on them for 1 turn (if all targets of the physical attack have already been defeated, the infliction of [Fainted] will not activate).
The number of turns of [Fainted] becomes 2.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, decreases all targets’ chance to resist a critical hit by 40% for 4 turns.

“Sink to the abyss!” screams Sabrina as she delivers a barrage of strikes, sending the enemy to the depths of the sea. Deals 5 physical attacks equal to 200% of her ATK to enemies at random. If Sabrina deals a critical hit, this skill’s remaining attacks are guaranteed to also deal critical hits. The sharp summer breeze then cuts through the water and chases the enemy down. If Sabrina deals 4 or more critical hits, this skill takes the enemy with the lowest remaining HP percentage among the targets of the physical attacks, dispels 1 of their buffs, and deals 1 physical attack equal to 400% of Sabrina’s ATK to them (if all targets of the physical attacks have already been defeated, the physical attack and the dispelling of the buff will not activate).
Additionally, each time an enemy is defeated by this skill, the number of additional attacks it deals increases by 1 (5 total additional attacks max).
The number of buffs that are dispelled becomes 2, and they are dispelled at the same time (the decision to dispel buffs based on Sabrina’s Debuff ACC is done only once).
The additional attack’s damage becomes equal to 600% of her ATK.

“I want to protect my comrades...” Even if Sabrina falls in battle, those feelings will never fade away. If she is defeated, this skill has a 50% chance to inflict [Fainted] on the enemy who attacked and defeated her for 1 turn. If Sabrina is defeated by a debuff, this skill will not activate.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases her chance to hit by 40% (cannot be dispelled).
The chance to inflict [Fainted] becomes 100%.

Sabrina has made her decision to live on with the scar in her heart. Her determination to bear the shackles of her past and move forward nurtures her power to live. Increases her max HP by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally increases her DEF by 40% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her max HP increases by becomes 40%. The amount her DEF increases by becomes 100%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Rest in Paradise. The targets of this skill become 4 random enemies.
Strengthens Rest in Paradise. The amount of ATK absorbed from the target becomes 30%.
Strengthens Rest in Paradise. The damage from [Poison] becomes equal to 5% of an afflicted target’s current HP.

levels.text: Spirits sleeping in eternal paradise awaken, dealing 1 magical attack equal to 330% of Moddey’s ATK to 3 random enemies. The anger the spirits feel from having their slumber disturbed transforms into a hex, inflicting [Poison] on all targets for 2 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Poison] deals damage equal to 3% of an afflicted target’s current HP.

Additionally, after the decision to inflict [Poison] has been made, takes the enemy with the highest ATK among all targets afflicted with [Poison], and absorbs 15% of that target’s ATK into Moddey’s own ATK for 2 turns.
The number of turns of [Poison] becomes 4.

Waterfronts are places where wandering spirits can easily make their way to. Once they spot a living being, the spirits form a swarm and rush in for the attack. Deals 3 magical attacks equal to 210% of Moddey’s ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, the number of attacks this skill deals increases by 1 for each enemy afflicted with [Poison] (8 total attacks max).
The number of initial magical attacks becomes 4, and the max total number of attacks becomes 9.
The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 230% of her ATK.
A gravekeeper makes everyone smile, whether they’re sleeping in their graves or not. That determination becomes Moddey’s new power. When Moddey is attacked, the attack’s damage is cut by 20%.
If the enemy that attacked Moddey is afflicted with [Poison], or when Moddey takes counterattack damage, the potency of damage cutting becomes 50%.
The damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by 50%. If the enemy that attacked Moddey is afflicted with [Poison], or when Moddey takes counterattack damage, the potency of damage cutting becomes 75%.

“Whenever I’m in danger, Laila always comes to save me.” At the start of each turn, this skill increases Moddey’s ATK by 3% (20 stacks, 60% max) (cannot be dispelled). Her ATK is further increased by 3% for each enemy that is afflicted with [Poison].
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 4%, and the max amount her ATK can increase by becomes 80%. Her ATK is further increased by 4% for each enemy that is afflicted with [Poison].
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 5%, and the max amount her ATK can increase by becomes 100%. Her ATK is further increased by 5% for each enemy that is afflicted with [Poison].

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Blooming Thunder. The increase in all targets’ chance to hit becomes 50%. The decrease in their chance to evade becomes 50%.
Strengthens Let’s Liven it Up! The targets of this skill become the 2 allies with the highest ATK.
Strengthens Blooming Thunder. The number of physical attacks becomes 5.

levels.text: “Feast your eyes as the world’s greatest gunslinger delivers a performance you’ll never forget!” Increases the chance to hit of the ally with the highest ATK by 25%, and decreases their chance to evade by 25% for 1 turn. These 2 effects are treated as 1 buff. “Enough with the tricks—it’s time for the real show to begin!” A large firework then explodes in the night sky, its sparks raining down on the enemies ruining the festival. Afterwards, this skill deals 4 physical attacks equal to 200% of Cordie’s ATK to enemies at random.
The number of turns of [Increased Chance to Hit] and [Decreased Chance to Evade] become 4. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 330% of her ATK.
The targets of [Increased Chance to Hit] and [Decreased Chance to Evade] become the 2 allies with the highest ATK.

A series of fireworks shoot up into the sky, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 200% of Cordie’s ATK to 4 random enemies. “Now, I’m all fired up!” The atmosphere of the festival sends Cordie to cloud nine. If the number of buffs she is enhanced with is 1 or more, the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 1.5.
Additionally restores HP equal to 30% of this skill’s total damage to the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 300% of her ATK.
The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.

“Let’s get louder, everyone! We’ve got a festival to enjoy!♪” At the start of the turn, this skill increases the ATK of the ally with the highest ATK by 20% of Cordie’s ATK for 1 turn. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
The number of turns of [Increased ATK] becomes 2.
The amount the target’s ATK increases by becomes equal to 60% of Cordie’s ATK.

It’s time for the world’s greatest gunslinger to show off exactly what she can do! Each time Cordie attacks, this skill increases both her DEF and M. DEF by 3% for 1 turn (10 stacks, 30% max) (cannot be dispelled). Her DEF and M. DEF are further increased by 3% for each attack she deals.
This skill also becomes activated each time Cordie is attacked. Her DEF and M. DEF are further increased by 3% for each attack dealt to her.

The amounts her DEF and M. DEF are increased by each become 10%, and their max increases both become 100%. Her DEF and M. DEF are further increased by 10% for each attack she deals, or is dealt to her.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Holy Night’s Gift. The targets of [Increased Chance to Deal a Critical Hit] after the physical attack is dealt becomes the 3 allies with the highest SPD other than Amour.
Strengthens Always by Your Side. The amount all targets’ ATK increases by becomes 40%.
Strengthens Red Thorns of Fate. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 340% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Here’s my gift of love...” Deals 1 physical attack equal to 180% of Amour’s ATK to 5 random enemies, and increases the chance to deal a critical hit of the ally with the highest SPD other than Amour by 30% for 2 turns.

Additionally, if this skill deals 1 or more critical hits, the ally target’s [Increased Chance to Deal a Critical Hit] is further increased by 5%. The ally target’s [Increased Chance to Deal a Critical hit] is further increased by 5% for each critical hit this skill deals (total increase of 55% max).
Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, increases Amour’s chance to deal a critical hit by 30% for 2 turns.

“Don’t even think of hurting my prince...!” Deals 2 physical attacks equal to 240% of Amour’s ATK to the enemy with the highest remaining HP percentage. However, the decision to select a target based on their remaining HP percentage is made with each individual attack. If no targets are defeated by this skill, it reactivates (1 reactivation max).
Additionally, if Amour’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or lower, the physical attacks’ damage is multiplied by 1.5.
The number of physical attacks becomes 3.
If Amour’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or lower, the amount the physical attacks’ damage is multiplied by becomes 2.

“I love you... Always...and forever...” If Amour is defeated, this skill revives her and restores HP equal to 25% of her max HP to her. Afterwards, this skill increases her max HP by 50% (cannot be dispelled). This skill activates only 1 time per battle.
After being revived, additionally increases the ATK of the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 20% for 3 turns.
After being revived, additionally decreases the skill cooldown time of the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 2.

“All it takes is just one thought of you to make my happiness overflow...” At the start of the battle, this skill decreases the damage the 2 allies adjacent to Amour take by 30%. A target’s [Decreased Damage Taken] is immediately dispelled when that target is attacked for the first time, instead of after a set number of turns have passed.
The targets of [Decreased Damage Taken] become all allies.
The decrease in damage all targets take becomes 60%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Miracle Stars. The amounts of ATK and DEF absorbed from the target each become 35%.
Strengthens Miracle Stars. The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 20% of the target’s current HP.
Strengthens Miracle Stars. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 100% of this skill’s total damage.

levels.text: “I’m gonna getcha!” Stars fly out of a mysterious hole connected to space-time, raining down on the enemy. Absorbs 15% of both the ATK and DEF of the enemy with the highest remaining HP into Tropon’s own ATK and DEF for 2 turns (the decision to absorb a stat based on Tropon’s Debuff ACC is done separately for each stat). Is this a Holy Night miracle, or a flashy trick? Afterwards, this skill deals 1 direct attack equal to 10% of the target’s current HP to them. This direct attack does not deal a critical hit, and its damage does not exceed 500% of Tropon’s current ATK (her ATK after it has absorbed the target’s ATK).
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 15% of the target’s current HP.
Additionally, grants Tropon [Shield] equal to 50% of this skill’s total damage for 2 turns.

Magic that transcends space-time flies out of the mysterious hole. What looks to be moving to the right moves left. What looks to be moving up moves diagonally and to the side. No one knows what will fly out, or from where. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 250% of Tropon’s ATK to 5 random enemies, and has a 10% chance to inflict [Fainted] on all targets for 1 turn.

Additionally, if no targets are defeated by this skill, increases the number of turns of every buff Tropon is enhanced with by 1. When this skill deals its attack, if a new buff is granted to Tropon, that new buff will also be affected.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 340% of her ATK.
The chance to inflict [Fainted] becomes 20%.
If someone wishes on a star on the Holy Night, their wish will come true. When Tropon attacks, this skill has a 10% chance to steal 1 buff from the target.
The chance to steal the target’s buff becomes 20%.
The chance to steal the target’s buff becomes 30%.
“My mom and dad were really nice, and they protected me with nice, white lies.” Increases Tropon’s max HP by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally increases her chance to inflict a debuff by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
The increases in her max HP and chance to inflict a debuff each become 40%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Préachán. The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 420% of her ATK.

Strengthens The Power of Bonds. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 200% of her ATK. The size of [Shield] is further increased by 200% of her ATK for each Crimson Soul ally other than Morgana who is alive at the start of the 1st turn (total increase of 1000% max).
Strengthens Bó Rua. The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 580% of her ATK.

levels.text: Morgana summons a black whirlwind that blows through the battlefield, sweeping away the foes standing in her way. Deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself, and deals 5 magical attacks equal to 320% of her ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, if Morgana is enhanced with Roused-Up Heart’s [Increased ATK] buff and its stack count is 2 or higher, restores HP equal to 10% of this skill’s total damage to her.
Additionally, each time she attacks, has a 50% chance to decrease the target’s incoming healing potency by 20% for 2 turns.

Morgana calls forth crimson spears that lunge towards the enemy, piercing right through them. Deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself, and deals 2 magical attacks equal to 420% of her ATK to enemies at random.
The number of magical attacks becomes 3.

Additionally, if Morgana is enhanced with Roused-Up Heart’s [Increased ATK] buff, the number of magical attacks is further increased by 1 for each [Increased ATK] buff that is stacked (7 total attacks max).
The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 520% of her ATK.

Whenever her loving heart fills with thoughts of her dear friends, Morgana surges with the courage to fight. If Morgana or an ally takes damage via dealing damage to self, this skill grants Morgana a buff that increases her ATK by 10% (cannot be dispelled). The buff’s stack count is further increased by 1 for each time she or an ally takes damage via dealing damage to self (4 stacks max).
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases her P. DEF by 25% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her P. DEF increases by becomes 50%.

“The bonds between us are the very power that lets us face off against demons!” At the start of the battle, this skill increases Morgana’s ATK by 5% (cannot be dispelled). Her ATK is further increased by 5% for each Crimson Soul ally other than Morgana who is alive at the start of the battle (total increase of 25% max).

Additionally, at the start of the 1st turn, grants Morgana [Shield] equal to 100% of her ATK for 6 turns (cannot be dispelled). The size of [Shield] is further increased by 100% of her ATK for each Crimson Soul ally other than Morgana who is alive at the start of the 1st turn (total increase of 500% max).
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 10%. Her ATK is further increased by 10% for each Crimson Soul ally other than Morgana who is alive at the start of the battle (total increase of 50% max).

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Sylph’s Whirlwind. The amount the target’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 15% of their max HP.
Strengthens Insight as a Healer. The increase in the max HP of the ally with the highest ATK other than Yuni becomes 50% of Yuni’s max HP.
Strengthens Unicorn’s Breeze. The amount the target’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 4% of Yuni’s max HP.

levels.text: “Come out, dear sylph. We are in need of your help!” Deals 1 magical attack equal to 150% of Yuni’s ATK to 5 random enemies. This skill also restores HP to the ally with the highest ATK other than Yuni equal to 10% of their max HP.
Additionally, if the target of the HP restoration is afflicted with a debuff, dispels 1 debuff from them.
The number of debuffs that are dispelled becomes 2.

“A healer’s job is to take away pain.” Restores HP equal to 2% of Yuni’s max HP to the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage. If the target is afflicted with a debuff, this skill dispels 1 debuff from them.
Additionally, this skill reactivates (1 reactivation max).
The amount the target’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 3% of Yuni’s max HP.
The max number of reactivations becomes 3.

“If anyone gets hurt, that’s what I’m here for.” At the start of the battle, this skill increases the max HP of the ally with the highest ATK other than Yuni by 15% of Yuni’s max HP (cannot be dispelled). From the 2nd turn until the 10th turn, at the start of each turn, this skill increases the max HP of the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage other than Yuni by 10% of Yuni’s max HP (9 stacks, 90% max) (cannot be dispelled).
From the 2nd turn until the 10th turn, at the start of each turn, after increasing the target’s max HP, additionally restores HP equal to 10% of Yuni’s ATK to that target.
The increase in the max HP of the ally with the highest ATK other than Yuni becomes 30% of Yuni’s max HP.
“Time and again, all those words of thanks shielded my heart from being crushed.” Increases both Yuni’s DEF and chance to resist a critical hit by 30% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases the incoming healing potency of the 2 allies adjacent to Yuni by 20% for 2 turns.
The increases in Yuni’s DEF and chance to resist a critical hit each become 50%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Wildcat Hunt. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 600% of her ATK.
Strengthens Gentle Fox Cub. The number of layers of [Multi-Barrier] becomes 3.
Strengthens Live for Revenge. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 700% of her ATK (1100% of her ATK max).

levels.text: “Aight... Should we get started with the huntin’?” Deals 1 physical attack equal to 450% of Minasumari’s ATK to 3 random enemies.
Additionally, if a target’s type is Sniper, the physical attack’s damage to that target is multiplied by 1.5, and becomes guaranteed to hit.
Additionally, if a target’s type is a type other than Sniper, has a 70% chance to decrease that target’s SPD by 15% for 2 turns.

The wounds, the bloodshed—they’ll be what sharpens the fangs I’ll sink into her throat. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 540% of Minasumari’s ATK to 2 random enemies. The physical attack’s damage is further increased by an amount equal to 10% of her ATK for each time Minasumari and an ally are attacked until this skill activates (740% of her ATK max) (for attacks that are dealt to multiple targets, each hit to an ally, including Minasumari, is counted).
The amount the physical attack’s damage is further increased by for each time Minasumari and an ally are attacked until this skill activates becomes equal to 20% of her ATK (940% of her ATK max).
The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 640% of her ATK (1040% of her ATK max).

“You wanna know how to erase all signs of your presence? That’s easy-peasy!” The way to silence one’s breath, and move without making a sound... What she teaches is akin to how a beast stalks its prey. At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Stealth] to Minasumari and the ally with the highest ATK for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled). If Minasumari is attacked and her remaining HP percentage becomes 50% or lower, or when she is defeated, the [Stealth] granted to her and the ally target by this skill is dispelled.
The number of turns of [Stealth] becomes 2.

If she is attacked and her remaining HP percentage becomes 50% or lower, additionally grants 1 layer of [Multi-Barrier] to her (cannot be dispelled). If she takes damage equal to 10% or more of her max HP, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.

Every time Minasumari sees someone collapse to the ground, she relives the memory of that day...and the resentment she keeps inside vividly reveals itself. When an ally other than Minasumari is defeated, this skill increases Minasumari’s ATK by 30% for each ally that was defeated (2 stacks, total increase of 60% max) (cannot be dispelled).
The increase in her ATK when an ally is defeated becomes 40% (2 stacks, total increase of 80% max).
The increase in her ATK when an ally is defeated becomes 50% (2 stacks, total increase of 100% max).

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Ninpo Midareba. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.
Strengthens Servant of the Moon. The decrease in damage she takes becomes 30%.
Strengthens Ninpo Hikagekuzushi. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Unleashing chaos everywhere!” Asahi hurls a barrage of bladed weapons from seemingly out of nowhere, dealing 5 physical attacks equal to 280% of her ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, if a physical attack is evaded, increases her chance to hit by 10% for 10 turns.
Additionally, if no targets are defeated by this skill, increases Asahi’s chance to deal a critical hit by 10% for 10 turns.

“Behind you... Ha!” Asahi silently creeps upon her foe, then uses a secret assassination technique passed down through her clan of shadows, dealing 4 physical attacks equal to 340% of her ATK to the enemy with the highest ATK.
The number of physical attacks becomes 5.
Additionally, if she is enhanced with Fuurinkazan’s [Increased ATK] buff and its stack count is 6 or higher, this skill reactivates (1 reactivation max).
Additionally, if she is enhanced with Fuurinkazan’s [Increased ATK] buff and its stack count is 12 or higher, this skill’s max number of reactivations becomes 2.

“Be swift as the wind, and silent as the forest... Learning from nature is the way of the shadows!” At the end of Asahi’s action phase, this skill grants her 1 stack of a buff that increases her ATK by 5% (15 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled).

Additionally, if the number of buffs Asahi is enhanced with at the end of her action phase is 4 or more, the number of stacks of the [Increased ATK] buff granted to her becomes 2 (buffs she is enhanced with are counted after their turn counts are decreased).

Additionally, if the number of buffs Asahi is enhanced with at the end of her action phase is 8 or more, the number of stacks of the [Increased ATK] buff granted to her becomes 3 (buffs she is enhanced with are counted after their turn counts are decreased).
“To live and be useful. That’s what it means to protect!” At the start of the battle, this skill decreases the damage Asahi takes by 15% for 10 turns.

Additionally, if there is 1 or more Amber Soul ally other than Asahi who is alive at the start of the battle, increases Asahi’s DEF by 150% and P. DEF by 100% for 10 turns. These 2 effects are treated as 1 buff.

Additionally, if there are 2 or more Amber Soul allies other than Asahi who are alive at the start of the
1st turn, grants Asahi [Shield] equal to 800% of her ATK for 10 turns.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Ancient Spell. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 440% of her ATK.
Strengthens Lost Technology. When an enemy dispels or steals a buff from Serruria, the increase in all allies’ chance to hit becomes 50%.
Strengthens Ancient Spell. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.

levels.text: Serruria takes an ancient relic she has researched and draws out its power, dealing 3 physical attacks equal to 240% of her ATK to enemies at random.

Additionally, the number of attacks this skill deals increases by 1 for each ally who has been defeated
(7 total attacks max).
Before dealing the physical attacks, if Serruria is enhanced with [No Restrictions], regardless of the number of allies who have been defeated, the number of attacks this skill deals becomes 7.
Serruria examines ancient symbols and unleashes the power hidden within them, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 480% of her ATK to 2 random enemies.
Additionally, the physical attack’s damage increases by 200% for each ally who has been defeated (1280% of her ATK max).
The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.

Before dealing the physical attack, if Serruria is enhanced with [No Restrictions], regardless of the number of allies who have been defeated, the physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1280% of her ATK.

The legacy of a civilization that fell into ruin long ago. Its enigmatic power responds when the one who possesses it faces imminent danger, revealing its true potential. When an enemy dispels or steals a buff from Serruria, this skill increases all allies’ chance to hit by 30% for 6 turns. Afterwards, this skill grants [No Restrictions] to Serruria (cannot be dispelled). [No Restrictions] increases Serruria’s ATK by 15%.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases her chance to hit by 10% for 6 turns.
The amount [No Restrictions] increases her ATK by becomes 30%.

The tireless effort that Serruria alone has put into her research has borne fruit, successfully drawing out the power of the relic. At the start of the 1st turn, this skill grants Serruria [Shield] equal to 400% of her ATK for
6 turns (cannot be dispelled).

Additionally, if the number of times Serruria is attacked during battle becomes 5, 10, 15, and 20, the [Shield] granted by this skill is regranted to Serruria. The regranting of [Shield] will not activate from the 3rd turn and onward.
The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 800% of her ATK.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Rondo of Courage. The targets of the magical attack become 3 random enemies.

Strengthens No Starving Allowed! The increase in the max HP of all allies other than Milla becomes 25%. If a target is an Emerald Soul ally, the amount that target’s max HP increases by is further increased by an amount equal to 200% of the granter’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it.

Strengthens Snack Stash. The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK. Before dealing the magical attacks, if the number of times active skills have restored HP to Milla during battle is 6 or more, the magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1920% of her ATK.

levels.text: As Milla sings while plucking the strings of her trusty guitar, she vows to never surrender, imbuing her melodies with her wishes. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 180% of her ATK to 2 random enemies, and has a 40% chance to inflict [Delay] on all targets for 1 turn. Each turn, at the end of the action phase, [Delay] stalls the decrease of an afflicted target’s skill cooldown time by 1, delaying their next skill activation. After the decision to inflict [Delay] on all enemy targets is made, this skill restores HP equal to 5% of Milla’s max HP to Milla.
The chance to inflict [Delay] becomes 70%.
The amount Milla’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 10% of her max HP.
“I mean, I can’t fight on an empty stomach, right?” Restores HP equal to 5% of Milla’s max HP to her. Afterwards, this skill deals 4 magical attacks equal to 280% of her ATK to enemies at random.

Additionally, before dealing the magical attacks, if the number of times active skills have restored HP to Milla during battle is 6 or more, the magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1120% of her ATK.
The amount Milla’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 10% of her max HP.

The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 440% of her ATK. Before dealing the magical attacks, if the number of times active skills have restored HP to Milla during battle is 6 or more, the magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1760% of her ATK.

“Starving is truly terrifying. That’s why I always keep my belly at least 80% full! Otherwise, I might hear those whispers in my head again...” At the start of the battle, this skill increases the max HP of all allies other than Milla by 10% (cannot be dispelled). If a target is an Emerald Soul ally, the amount that target’s max HP increases by is further increased by an amount equal to 100% of the granter’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it. Afterwards, this skill increases Milla’s max HP by an amount equal to 200% of the granter’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it (cannot be dispelled).
The amount Milla’s max HP increases by becomes equal to 500% of the granter’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it.
The increase in the max HP of all allies other than Milla becomes 15%.

“I want to share these with everyone—the warmth and joy that fills our bellies and hearts!” At the start of the turn, this skill grants [Regeneration] to all allies for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled). Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Regeneration] restores HP equal to 5% of an enhanced target’s max HP to them. This skill will not activate again until 6 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
Additionally, if an enhanced target is an Emerald Soul ally, the amount [Regeneration] restores that enhanced target’s HP by becomes 10% of their max HP.
This skill now activates again after 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation, and the number of turns of [Regeneration] becomes 4.
